_meta.status: PILOT v4 - D-032. Not registered in CLAIMS.md, not on the site.
rules: Ad account spends in US dollars (tested by CPM: naira accounts show CPMs of 500+)
The study's per-group report reconciles with Meta's reported spend, so group costs add up to the total
At least $500 of advertising and at least 200 qualified respondents
Recruitment waves only: baseline or single-wave studies. Follow-up waves re-contact people and are excluded
Studies that fed one survey at the same time are combined: spend summed, respondents counted once
The targeting can be stated in a sentence, and it did what it said

definitions.qualified_respondent: a person counted toward one of the study's quota groups: they are in the targeted group and completed the screening (the study's own quota rule, e.g. answered through to the phone-number question). Taken from the study's latest optimisation report (FACEBOOK_ADOPT current_participants).
definitions.ad_cost: Meta-reported advertising spend (per-group lifetime_spent, which reconciles with Insights) / qualified respondents. Excludes incentives, the survey platform and our fee.

terms.whole_state: ads shown to people Meta places anywhere inside the state's official boundary
terms.state_group: several whole states targeted together in one ad set (a Meta region list). Group names on the page are ours; the study's ids (eastern, focal_rec, midwest, ne_rec, other_rec) are raw labels and are never published
terms.qualified_respondent: a person aged 18-34 who said they live in the United States, gave a name, phone and email, and opened the study's enrolment survey (quota rule: answered 'sguid', the id the enrolment survey hands back)

all_people_surveyed.note: Distinct user_id in inference_data across the 15 single-country US studies on the current platform (13 have any data). user_id is scoped to a Facebook page, so one person reached through two pages counts twice.

study.incentive: $10 Amazon gift card for the first survey (study offered $10/$5/$20/$5/$30 over five surveys)
study.channel: Messenger (Facebook and Instagram ads); screening in Messenger, then a link to the study's own enrolment survey
study.eligibility: aged 18-34 and living in the United States (the screener's only disqualifying questions)
study.quota_rule: opened the enrolment survey link after giving name, phone and email
study.quotas: Location (5 groups of whole states) × Gender (Meta genders), ages 18-34 targeted in every group: 10 groups
study.account_currency: USD (ad account 1342820622846299; recruitment budget $12,500 set in dollars; the same account shows a $22 CPM on a 2025 US study)
study.ad_days_note: days with spend > 0 between 8 May and 7 Nov 2023 (169 calendar days with an Insights row)

by_month_note: Insights spend in the calendar month / people whose enrolment-survey id arrived that month (inference_data 'sguid', 31 people without ad metadata left out, so the months sum to 4,956 against the report's 4,932). Oct: the 1 Oct strata change set women's quota to 0 in the South-and-East group and raised men's in four groups; reverted 31 Oct.
checks: report (2023-11-07 20:31 UTC) per-stratum lifetime_spent equals Insights per ad set to the cent; report total $12,171.67 of Insights $12,758.89

the $587.22 gap is 40 ad sets run 8-22 May (location × gender × race × days of use) before the study collapsed to 10 strata on 22 May; same state lists and genders, so their spend is assigned by id. With it, groups sum to $12,758.89 = Insights
state lists identical in all six strata versions (5, 12, 22, 28 May; 1, 31 Oct), and the five groups partition the 50 states and DC exactly
no sibling study: of 8,362 people, 12 appear in any other study (7 llm-bias-survey-us, 5 in European/central Asian studies, likely staff tests)
2 test entries 17-19 Apr before ads; every other person arrived 8 May - 7 Nov
screener (Fly form B85Ep3Ad, all versions from 8 May): ineligible only if age <18 or >34 or country not US; days of marijuana use is asked but does not screen
strata_note: Stratum ids are the study's own labels. Gender 1 = men and 2 = women (Meta genders). The '_rec' groups match the states with legal recreational cannabis in spring 2023 (INFERRED from the labels and the lists; not published).

quota_rule_is_not_a_screen: vapefree-evaluation-aim3: $1,554.94, 856 'qualified' of 882 - the quota rule is the first message of the chat; the real screen ran on an external site whose outcomes we do not hold. 18-25, Android phones only, whole country. Cost per person who opened the chat: men $2.51, women $1.32
targeting_not_as_stated: racial-attitudes-project: the 'southwest' and 'west' groups both contain Arizona, Colorado, Nevada, New Mexico and Utah; Oklahoma and DC are in no group. Also 80-95 qualified per region and two incentive-framing arms. $940.20, 440 qualified, 11 days
